name: awaitonal
description: Local musical notifications for how your coding agent leaves things.

interface.shortDescription: Hear how your coding agent left things
interface.longDescription: Classify final replies locally and synthesize musical cues for completion, findings, feedback, and required action. Uses a shared local service with explicit setup and mute controls. Audio playback currently targets macOS.
defaultPrompt: Set up Awaitonal notifications in Codex.
